name: Nova IV
storyline: Resurrected by a mysterious entity after the events of Nova III, it's up to you to travel distant worlds, clear their demon infestations, and uncover the mysteries of your benefactor.
summary: Nova IV is a 33-map MBF21 compatible megawad designed by newer or intermediate Doom mappers, built over the span of 16 months by some of the most talented fresh faces in the community.
